No Excuse Absentee Polling Places

No Excuse Absentee Voting is an in-person absentee option for all voters during the two weeks before each election. No absentee voting excuse is necessary, and you do not need to apply for a ballot. You can cast your vote at any of the locations below. Call libraries to confirm hours of operations.

Polling Place Data

In North Carolina, voters have two options for voting in person:

  1. Voters may vote on Election Day at their designated polling place, determined by their residential address.
  2. Voters may vote early during the early voting period at any early voting site in their county.

On this page, you can find Election Day polling place data and early voting site data for current and past elections.

Polling Place Data

In North Carolina, voters have two options for voting in person:

  1. Voters may vote on Election Day at their designated polling place, determined by their residential address.
  2. Voters may vote early during the early voting period at any early voting site in their county.

On this page, you can find Election Day polling place data and early voting site data for current and past elections.

<article id="post-90876" class="page post-90876 type-page status-publish has-post-thumbnail hentry">
<header class="entry-header d-flex justify-content-between card-style rov-card-style">
		<div class="cntr-title-subtitle text-center">
			<h1 class="entry-title rov-title">2026 General Election</h1>
							<p class="subtitle-text"><p style="text-align: center"><strong>November 3, 2026</strong></p></p>
					</div><!-- cntr-title-subtitle -->
			</header><!-- .entry-header -->

	<div class="entry-content">
		  <section data-isd-block-id="rov-content-blockblock_9589315080062d469a07aab713811807"
										 											 class="card-style main-content-wrapper rov-card-style mb-4">

	<h2 class="block-subtitle blue">Key Dates and Deadlines</h2>

	<div class="ctnr-block-content"><table class="table table-striped" style="width: 99%">
<thead>
<tr style="text-align: left">
<th role="presentation"><strong>Date </strong></th>
<th role="presentation"><strong>Action</strong></th>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>July 13, 2026</td>
<td>Candidate filing begins for all offices</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>August 7, 2026</td>
<td>Candidate filing deadline for all offices</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>September 29, 2026</td>
<td>County Voter Information Guides delivered to U.S. Post Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>October 5, 2026</td>
<td>Mail Ballots delivered to U.S. Post Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>October 5, 2026</td>
<td>Early voting begins</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>October 19, 2026</td>
<td>Voter registration deadline</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>October 27, 2026</td>
<td>Deadline to request a replacement mail ballot</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>November 3, 2026</strong></td>
<td><strong>Election Day – 2026 General Election</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>November 4, 2026</td>
<td>Canvass of the Election begins</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>December 3, 2026</td>
<td>Deadline to complete the official canvass and certify the results</td>
</tr>
</thead>
</table>
</div>

  </section>

	

  <section data-isd-block-id="rov-content-blockblock_1ca625227c22964596d9025f75778ca0"
										 											 class="card-style main-content-wrapper rov-card-style mb-4">

	<h2 class="block-subtitle blue">Election Publications</h2>

	<div class="ctnr-block-content"><p><strong>County of San Bernardino Voter Information Guide</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>The <strong>Voter Information Guide</strong> is a booklet published by the San Bernardino County Registrar of Voters that includes information about voting, candidates and measures, a sample ballot, and polling place information.</li>
<li>The <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/VIG.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>comprehensive Voter Information Guide</strong></a> [pdf] contains information for all offices and measures up for election throughout San Bernardino County.</li>
<li>The <strong>precinct specific Voter Information Guide</strong> contains information for offices and measures up for election in each precinct. You can view your precinct specific Voter Information Guide by using the <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/voting/ppl/2026/1103/"><strong>Polling Place and Voter Information Guide Lookup tool</strong></a>.</li>
<li>The <a href="https://ca.omniballot.us/sites/06071/SanBernardino_ASB/app/home" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>accessible format Voter Information Guide</strong></a> provides customized election information for voters who use screen-reader software.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>State of California Voter Information Guide</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>The California Secretary of State has also publishes a <a href="https://vig.cdn.sos.ca.gov/2026/general/pdf/complete-vig.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>Voter Information Guide</strong></a> [pdf] which includes information about candidates for statewide offices and state propositions.</li>
</ul>
<p><a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/news/"><strong>Press Releases and Public Notices</strong></a></p>
</div>

  </section>

	

  <section data-isd-block-id="rov-content-blockblock_4aabcfb1626ac68f33dbfc1cd6e87487"
										 											 class="card-style main-content-wrapper rov-card-style mb-4">

	<h2 class="block-subtitle blue">Voter Registration</h2>

	<div class="ctnr-block-content"><p>If you want a ballot mailed to you, your voter registration application must be postmarked no later than October 19, 2026.</p>
<ul>
<li>Visit our <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/VoterRegistration/">Voter Registration page</a> for complete information and instructions about registering to vote.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>If you miss the voter registration deadline, </strong>you can still register and vote in person at the Registrar of Voters office or an Early Voting Location on or before Election Day or at a polling place on Election Day.</p>
<ul>
<li>View the <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/Voting/Early/">Vote Early</a> webpage for locations, dates, and hours of the Early Voting Locations for this election.</li>
<li>Use the <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/voting/ppl/2026/1103/">Polling Place Look-up tool</a> to find your polling place.</li>
<li>View the <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/rov/News/2026/1103/PublicNotice_PollingPlaceCentralCount.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">List of Polling Places</a> [pdf] to find all locations.</li>
</ul>
<p>View the Registration Summary of Qualified Voters [available soon] for this election.</p>
<p>Up until the close of the polls at 8 p.m. on Election Day, all voters can still update their residential address or political party preference.</p>
<ul>
<li>For more information, view <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/VoterRegistration/How/#AfterCOR">instructions and a Change of Address Form</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

  </section>

	

  <section data-isd-block-id="rov-content-blockblock_110ec919b97ef7c9d4d7c8569d69bd88"
										 											 class="card-style main-content-wrapper rov-card-style mb-4">

	<h2 class="block-subtitle blue">Voting Options</h2>

	<div class="ctnr-block-content"><p><strong>Voting options:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Vote early at the Registrar of Voters beginning October 5, 2026.</li>
<li>Vote early at an Early Voting Location.
<ul>
<li>View the <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/Voting/Early/">Early Voting Locations</a> and hours of operation.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Vote a Mail Ballot.
<ul>
<li>Mail ballot applications are not necessary. Ballots are mailed to all active registered voters.</li>
<li>To request a replacement mail ballot:
<ul>
<li>Call the Registrar of Voters at (909) 387-8300</li>
<li>Submit a <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Application_MBReplacement.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Replacement Mail Ballot Application</a> [pdf]</li>
<li>Visit the Registrar of Voters office, October 5 through November 3
<ul>
<li>Monday – Friday, 8 a.m. – 5 p.m.</li>
<li>Saturday, October 31, 8 a.m. – 5 p.m.</li>
<li>Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 7 a.m. – 8 p.m.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Visit an <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/Voting/Early/">Early Voting Location</a></li>
<li>Authorize another person to pick-up your mail ballot with an <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/rov/Elections/2024/1105/Application_VotersRepresentative.pdf">Application to Provide Vote-By-Mail Ballot to an Authorized Representative</a> [pdf]
<ul>
<li>Official ballots may be picked up beginning Monday, October 5</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Voters may return their voted mail ballot:
<ul>
<li>At a Ballot Drop Box Location
<ul>
<li>View the list of <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/News/2026/1103/PublicNotice_MailBallot_DropOffLocations.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ballot Drop Box Locations</a> [pdf]</li>
<li>View a map of Ballot Drop Box Locations [available soon]</li>
<li>Ballots must be returned no later than 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>By mail via the U.S. Postal Service
<ul>
<li>No postage required</li>
<li>Ballots must be postmarked on or before Tuesday, November 3 and received by the Registrar of Voters within seven days following the election.
<ul>
<li>Voters that mail their ballot on or close to Election Day, should go inside any U.S. Post Office and request a manual postmark to ensure their ballot is dated on time.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Drop off at an <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/Voting/Early/">Early Voting Location</a></li>
<li>Drop off at any <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/rov/News/2026/1103/PublicNotice_PollingPlaceCentralCount.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Polling Place</a> [pdf] on Election Day</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Vote a <a href="https://ca.omniballot.us/sites/06071/SanBernardino_RAVBM/app/home">Remote Accessible Vote by Mail Ballot</a> using your computer and printer to:
<ul>
<li>Mark your ballot</li>
<li>Print your voted ballot</li>
<li>Place your voted ballot in your Mail Ballot Return Envelope or in your own envelope with mailing labels attached</li>
<li>Sign and date your envelope</li>
<li>Return your ballot by mail or to a <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/rov/News/2026/1103/PublicNotice_PollingPlaceCentralCount.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Polling Place</a> [pdf], <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/Voting/Early/">Early Voting Location</a>, or <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/News/2026/1103/PublicNotice_MailBallot_DropOffLocations.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ballot Drop Box Location</a> [pdf]</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Voters with a disability:</strong></p>
<p>Voters with a disability may vote independently using:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://ca.omniballot.us/sites/06071/SanBernardino_RAVBM/app/home">Remote Accessible Vote by Mail</a>, using their computer, voters can mark an accessible ballot.</li>
<li>An accessible ballot marking device which includes audio and large text options, voters can view, mark and print their ballot.</li>
</ul>
<p>Visit our <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/voting/">Voting Options</a> page for complete information and instructions.</p>
<p><strong>Military and Overseas Voters:</strong></p>
<p>Uniformed and Overseas citizens can obtain a <a href="https://ca.omniballot.us/sites/06071/SanBernardino_VIG/app/home">Voter Information Guide</a> as well as a <a href="https://ca.omniballot.us/sites/06071/SanBernardino_UOCAVA/app/home" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ballot</a> for this election. For complete information, visit the Secretary of State’s website for <a href="https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/voter-registration/military-overseas-voters">Military and Overseas Voters</a>.</p>
</div>

  </section>

	

  <section data-isd-block-id="rov-content-blockblock_d14804fa0f64d0e2741aba4a347aec40"
										 											 class="card-style main-content-wrapper rov-card-style mb-4">

	<h2 class="block-subtitle blue">Offices and Candidates Information</h2>

	<div class="ctnr-block-content"><p><strong>Offices Up For Election:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>View the <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Report_OfficesUpForElection.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">List of Offices Up for Election</a> [pdf]</li>
<li>View the <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Report_RunOffContests.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">List of Offices Proceeding to a Run-Off</a> [pdf]</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Candidate Filing:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Schedule a Candidate Filing Appointment [no longer available]</li>
<li>View the <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Guide_CandidateFiling.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Candidate Filing Guide</a> [pdf]</li>
<li>View the <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Notice_CS_SubmissionRequirements.pdf">Candidate Statement Submission Requirements</a> [pdf]</li>
<li>View the <a href="https://elections.cdn.sos.ca.gov/statewide-elections/2026-primary/election-guide/section-07-general-election-calendar.pdf">Secretary of State’s 2026 General Election Calendar</a> [external link]</li>
<li>View the <a href="https://elections.cdn.sos.ca.gov/statewide-elections/2026-primary/election-guide/section-9-offices-subdivisions.pdf">Secretary of State’s lists of Offices and Subdivisions within Counties</a> [external link]</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Candidate Statements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>View the <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/PublicNotice_CandidateStatementEstimates.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Estimated Candidate Statement Costs</a> [pdf]
<ul>
<li>Candidates are required to pay the estimated costs of printing their candidate statement in the Voter Information Guide at the time of filing.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Use the <a href="https://www.sbcounty.gov/uploads/ROV/OfficialsandCandidates/eFORM_Generic_Candidate_Statement.docx">Candidate Statement Form</a> [docx] to prepare a candidate statement</li>
</ul>

	<div class="ctnr-block-content"><p>Request a precinct specific translated sample ballot for the November 3, 2026, General Election:</p>

<li><a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Form_TranslatedBallotRequest_KO.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">한국어로 번역된 견본 투표용지 요청서</a></li>

<li><a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Form_TranslatedBallotRequest_MA.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Permohonan Undian Sampel Terjemahan dalam Bahasa Melayu</a></li>
<li><a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Form_TranslatedBallotRequest_NE.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">नेपालीमा अनुवादित नमूना मतपत्रको लागि अनुरोध</a></li>
<li><a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Form_TranslatedBallotRequest_TA.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Kahilingan para sa Isinalin na Halimbawang Balota sa Tagalog</a></li>
<li><a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Form_TranslatedBallotRequest_TH.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">คำขอรับบัตรลงคะแนนตัวอย่ำงฉบับแปลเป็นภำษำไทย</a></li>
<li><a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Form_TranslatedBallotRequest_VI.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Yêu Cầu Mẫu Lá Phiếu Đã Dịch bằng Tiếng Việ</a></li>
</ul>
<p>Review translated sample ballots with all contests for the November 3, 2026, General Election [available soon]:</p>
<ul>
<li>為幫助選民使用官方選票進行投票，這份說明包含中文版的選票樣本。</li>
<li>आधिकारिक मतपत्र पर मतदान करने में मतदाताओं की सहायता के लिए, इस गाइड में हिंदी में अनुवादित नमूना मतपत्र पृष्ठ शामिल हैं।</li>
<li>Untuk membantu pemilih dalam memilih Surat Suara Resmi, panduan ini berisi contoh halaman surat suara yang diterjemahkan ke dalam Bahasa Indonesia.</li>
<li>ដើម្បីជួយអ្នកបោះឆ្នោតក្នុងការបោះឆ្នោតលើសន្លឹកឆ្នោតផ្លូវការ មគ្គុទ្ទេសក៍នេះមានទំព័រគំរូ  សន្លឹកឆ្នោតដែលបានបកប្រែជាភាសាខ្មែរ។</li>
<li>유권자가 공식 투표 용지로 투표하는 것을 돕기 위해 본 안내서에는 한국어로 번역된 샘플 투표 용지 페이지가 포함되어 있습니다.</li>
<li>ເພື່ອຊ່ວຍເຫຼືອໃຫ້ຜູ້ມີສິດເລືອກຕັ້ງສາມາດລົງຄະແນນສຽງຢ່າງເປັນທາງການໄດ້ ຄູ່ມືນີ້ຈຶ່ງມີຕົວຢ່າງໜ້າບັດເລືອກຕັ້ງທີ່ແປເປັນພາສາລາວໃຫ້ໄວ້ເຊັ່ນກັນ.</li>
<li>Untuk membantu pengundi dalam mengundi melalui Undi Rasmi, panduan ini mengandungi contoh muka surat undi yang diterjemahkan ke dalam bahasa Melayu.</li>
<li>आधिकारिक मतपत्रमा मतदान गर्न मतदाताहरूलाई सहयोग गर्न, यस निर्देशिकामा नेपालीमा अनुवाद गरिएका नमूना मतपत्र पृष्ठहरू समावेश छन्।</li>
<li>Para matulungan ang mga botante sa pagboto sa Opisyal na Balota, naglalaman ang gabay na ito ng mga pahina ng sample na balota na nakasalin sa Tagalog.</li>
<li>เพื่อช่วยเหลือผู้ลงคะแนนในการลงคะแนนเสียงบัตรเลือกตั้งของทางการ คู่มือนี้มีตัวอย่างหน้าบัตรลงคะแนนที่แปล เป็นภาษาไทย</li>
<li>Để hỗ trợ các cử tri trong việc bầu Lá Phiếu Chính Thức, hướng dẫn này bao gồm các trang lá phiếu mẫu được dịch sang tiếng Việt.</li>
</ul>
</div>

  <section data-isd-block-id="rov-content-blockblock_2602f9c65fae3926f50ca314127b209d"
										 												id="Cure"
															   											 class="card-style main-content-wrapper rov-card-style mb-4">

	<h2 class="block-subtitle blue">Resolving Unsigned and Non-Matching Signatures on Mail Ballots and Provisional Ballots</h2>

	<div class="ctnr-block-content"><p>When the Registrar of Voters receives a voted mail ballot or provisional ballot without the voter’s signature on the identification envelope or is unable to compare the voter’s signature on the return envelope with the signature on file in the voter’s record, the Registrar of Voters is unable to count that ballot. However, California law allows voters another chance to correct their mail ballot or provisional ballot up until November 25, 2026. These voters are notified by mail that they may:</p>
<ul>
<li>Go to the Registrar of Voters in person to sign the mail ballot or provisional ballot identification envelope or sign the Signature Verification and Unsigned Identification Envelope Statement;</li>
<li>Complete and return a Signature Verification and Unsigned Identification Envelope Statement; or</li>
<li>Fix the ballot identification envelope online [available soon].</li>
</ul>
<p>If you received a letter from the Registrar of Voters stating that your mail ballot or provisional ballot return envelope was not signed or your signature did not compare with your signature on file, complete and return a Signature Verification and Unsigned Identification Envelope Statement immediately.</p>
<p><strong><em>For mail ballots:</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/Elections/2026/1103/Form_UBS-SVS-MB.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Signature Verification and Unsigned Identification Envelope Statement</a> [pdf]</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>For provisional ballots:</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Signature Verification and Unsigned Identification Envelope Statement [available soon]</li>
</ul>
</div>

  </section>

	<div class="entry-content">
		  <section data-isd-block-id="rov-content-blockblock_9e6fc3cb7a723f1b2b2779fb6ce3a42e"
										 											 class="card-style main-content-wrapper rov-card-style mb-4">

	<h2 class="block-subtitle blue">November 3, 2026, General Election</h2>

	<div class="ctnr-block-content"><p>The Ballot Drop Box Location map identifies the locations throughout San Bernardino County where voters can drop off their Mail Ballots for the <strong>2026 General Election</strong><strong>.</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>View a full-screen map of the <a href="https://sbcounty.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/nearby/index.html?appid=c41163bc53bc43d68bcabd48c68a0b7d">Ballot Drop Box Locations</a></li>
<li>View the <a href="https://uploads.rov.sbcounty.gov/ROV/News/2026/1103/PublicNotice_MailBallot_DropOffLocations.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">List of Ballot Drop Box Locations</a> [pdf]
<ul>
<li>Secure, outdoor Ballot Drop Boxes will be open by Monday, October 5 through 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3.</li>
<li>Staffed, indoor ballot boxes will be available beginning Monday, October 5, through Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, during regular business hours.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>For more information on returning mail ballots, visit the <a href="https://elections.sbcounty.gov/Voting/">Voting Options</a> page.</li>
</ul>
</div>

  </section>

	


<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
